objective: Reject duplicate parcel identities during planning and independent verification, and keep replay configuration current.
acceptance: duplicate tracking_id, barcode, or parcel_uid values fail closed before manipulation
world-model verification independently refutes duplicate parcel identities
place actions retain an identity guard marker
scripted place requests preserve policy, priority, reason, and capacity metadata
dashboard replay uses the latest visible task graph and configured priorities
evidence: dashboard replay and priority source tests
stop_conditions: identity data is absent, in which case the normal evidence policy remains active
conditional execution would require a new contract
mobile navigation or parcel-locker access is requested
